_why: W18-DENSITY-B4-B5, 2026-09-04 (CL-O4 density half; addendum sections B/C; owner directive 2026-09-04-C sections 2-3). Band 5 is short on purpose (D70) and P-5.3 keeps its ROAD untouched, so every candy here sits off the road's own line at a place the band already names -- the outer watch, the danger beat, the scorched pocket P-5.2 announces, the Sigil gate's wing, the dell behind the waystop, the doorstep alpha -- and the only on-road entries are three basic supplies (a potion at the mouth, a potion before the checkpoint, the road watch's dropped candy) per the directive's 'main routes: occasional basic supplies'. Nothing is authored inside the waystop clearing (R-5: nothing at the waystop heals for free; R-1: three things and nothing else). Recovery arrives before Corr, before the alpha pack and before Ness, not after. docs/decisions/D78 records why pickups are allowed where P-5.3 said 'not a cache'. Loaded by scripts/world/band_pickups.gd, persisted by `id`; every position probed on the real world (tools/_probe_band_density.gd).

pickups.why: The road watch's abandoned drop (props.json order 5002), on the road: the band's one critical-path candy, a Good where Team Tether left in a hurry.
65m west of the road at the seam, between the burrowback and duskhush clusters (orders 5016/5007): the first side-ground of the approach, Good.
Behind Watchman Corr's outer watch (trainers `stronghold_outer_watch`, props order 5000), 45m off the road: the occupation's own supply spill, Good.
The west shoulder where the drained ground runs out toward the flank, above the meadowhart three (order 5019): side exploration on the approach, Good.
The scorched pocket's south lip, 55m east of the road: a Good on the way into the detour P-5.2 announces, so the pocket pays from its edge inward.
The pipwing flock's roost (order 5018) on the east flank, the far way round to the pocket: ordinary side ground, Good.
The dell behind the waystop, 55m outside its clearing (R-5/R-1 keep the clearing itself untouched): a Good for the player who walks the edges before committing to the Hall.

Behind the alpha Galecrest pack of three at (-25,7255) -- the encounter contract's 'danger beat', the largest aggressive cluster in the chapter: a Great guarded by the band's hardest ordinary fight. N14-ROUTED-FOLLOWUPS moved this coordinate on 2026-09-05, from N02-VEGETATION's routed finding §7: the authored spot sat inside solid scatter and `band_pickups.gd`'s nudge search could not find clear ground for it, so the world warned `sits inside solid scatter... move it` on every boot. The new coordinate is MEASURED, not guessed -- `tools/_probe_n14_pickup_ground.gd` asked the same `vegetation.gd::has_solid_scatter_near` query the placer uses over a 0.5m grid around the authored spot and reported the nearest genuinely clear cell. The place this find is about is unchanged; only the metre or so it stands on moved. Nearest clear ground was 0.5m out -- the nudge search's smallest ring is 2.0m, so it stepped straight over half a metre of clear ground and then ran out of rings.
The heart of the scorched pocket beside the Sunstone (121,7336) and the TM (140,7300): P-5.2's announced detour is the band's one sanctioned point of interest, and it pays a Great.
At the Sigil gate's east wing on the near side, 40m off the road: the payoff of three captains stands here, and a Great beside it says the wall was worth walking up to.

Beside the doorstep alpha (order 5015's promoted first member, R-3: the strongest wild in the chapter, in silhouette against the Hall), outside its 18m radius and outside the waystop's clearing: the band's single Rare, at its hardest optional encounter.
At the mouth, 30m before Watchman Corr: basic supplies before the approach's first fight and the alpha pack 130m behind him.
35m off the road, 50m before the alpha Galecrest pack: a revive found before the danger beat, not after it.
On the scorched pocket's drained ground: the pocket's stronger supply, an attack buff for the gauntlet a player is walking toward.
On the road 60m before Warder Ness at the checkpoint: the last basic supply before the waystop decision, found before the fight it supports.
